The main takeaway from our work is that

the ACT combination of AS + SP should be maintained as a first-line treatment for falciparum uncomplicated malaria in Yemen, but that a single dose primaquin should be added to the treatment regimen to clear the gametocyte reservoir and prevent transmission.
AS + PYR + PRQ (artesunate plus pyrimethamine plus primaquine) should be considered as the new first line ACT in Yemen, and in other areas of Yemen where the same resistance profile is observed.
the use of ACTs should not be discontinued in areas where SP resistance is high, but should be complemented by the use of a gametocytocidal agent to reduce transmission.
